newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform across the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Outperform across the bloc.

text.p: Australian bond spreads narrowed against other dollar-bloc countries, as a combination of offshore buying and positive local sentiment saw bond rally strongly on the day.
The gains were most noticeable against Canadian bonds, which eased in line with Treasuries and on squaring of long positions ahead of Tuesday's Canada Day holiday.

As well, traders said there was swapping out of Canadian dollar assets into Australian dollar ones, a move which not only helped the local bond market but also saw the Australian dollar rally one cent.
Spreads are expected to remain well-supported ahead of 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) Wednesday when the Reserve Bank of Australia could announce an interest rate cut.

While the local market could pull back if there is no announcement on Wednesday, traders said losses would be limited by the fact that most see Thursday or later in the month after wages and inflation data as more likely times for a rate cut.
